description: This file defines an abstract class HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag, which represents a tag token (start, end, or empty) in an HTML purification library. It manages properties like tag name and attributes, and ensures consistent casing and attribute normalization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Token_Tag
classes.description: Represents an HTML tag token with properties for tag name, attributes, and type marker.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a tag token instance, normalizing the tag name and attributes to lowercase.
